attributes.action: Pressure the government for a nationwide anti climate change action plan
attributes.additional_details: Climate change is a HUGE worldwide issue. Temperatures are rising drastically and quickly, we need to make an attempt to stop what we can. I think the government should try and come up with a nationwide plan on what we as a country can do to help this awful event.
attributes.background: I want to pressure the English government into helping reverse what we can on climate change. It is getting completely out of have and we need to attempt to stop what we can. If England does this plan, who knows if other country's might join in?

rejection.details:
The UK Government already has a climate and clean energy plan: https://www.gov.uk/government/news/climate-plan-captures-clean-energy-benefits-and-boosts-investment

We are not clear what else you are asking for.
